senses.gloss:
1 लिह् लेढि लीढे लिहति pp. लीढ lick, lick up,
lick at (loc.), lick away i.e. destroy. C. लेह॑यति cause to lick. I.
लेलिह्यते etc. (pp. लेलिहान) lick frequently, play with the tongue.
— अव, आ, उद् lick, touch (with mouth or beak). उप M. enjoy by
licking. निस् lick off, sip. परि lick at (acc.);
 I. lick frequently.
वि the same. सम् & परिसम् lick at, enjoy. — Cf. आलीढ, उल्लीढ.
